edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the key receiving the whole initial supply.
totalSupply state variable is assigned inside the constructor.
Constructor writes balanceOf[msg.sender] with the minted supply.
initialSupply parameter drives totalSupply computation.
tokenName parameter is assigned to name.
tokenSymbol parameter is assigned to symbol.
Constructor performs unchecked multiplication initialSupply * 10 ** decimals.
Unchecked multiplication result is stored into totalSupply and can overflow.
_from parameter is read for balanceOf lookups.
_to parameter receives the transferred balance.
_value parameter is subtracted and added on balances.
previousBalances local is compared in the final assert of _transfer.
balanceOf reads and writes occur throughout _transfer.
_transfer mutates balances without SafeMath, risking overflow and underflow.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value can wrap around.
_to parameter of transfer is forwarded to _transfer.
_value parameter of transfer is forwarded to _transfer.
transfer passes msg.sender as the _from argument of _transfer.
transfer calls the internal _transfer routine.
_from parameter of transferFrom is forwarded to _transfer.
_to parameter of transferFrom is forwarded to _transfer.
_value parameter of transferFrom is spent from allowance and forwarded.
allowance mapping is read and decremented in transferFrom.
msg.sender is used as the spender key of the allowance lookup.
transferFrom calls the internal _transfer routine.
transferFrom decrements allowance without SafeMath.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value may underflow.
_spender parameter is the allowance key in approve.
_value parameter is stored as the approved allowance.
msg.sender is the owner key when setting allowance.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
_spender parameter is cast to a tokenRecipient contract.
_value parameter is forwarded to approve and to the callback.
_extraData parameter is forwarded into the external callback.
approveAndCall calls approve before performing the external call.
approveAndCall performs an external call to an arbitrary spender contract that can reenter the token.
local spender variable is the target of the external receiveApproval call.
Control returns from the untrusted callee into approveAndCall after receiveApproval, enabling state manipulation.
_value parameter of burn is deducted from balanceOf and totalSupply.
burn reads and writes balanceOf[msg.sender].
msg.sender is the account whose tokens are burned.
burn decrements totalSupply without SafeMath.
totalSupply -= _value can underflow in burn.
_from parameter of burnFrom is the account debited.
_value parameter of burnFrom is deducted from balance and allowance.
burnFrom reads and writes balanceOf[_from].
burnFrom reads and writes allowance[_from][msg.sender].
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is consumed.
burnFrom decrements balanceOf[_from] without SafeMath.
burnFrom decrements allowance without SafeMath.
burnFrom decrements totalSupply without SafeMath.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value may underflow in burnFrom.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value may underflow in burnFrom.
totalSupply -= _value may underflow in burnFrom.

normalization_plan.reason: initialSupply is only consumed by the constructor when computing totalSupply.
tokenName is only assigned to the name state variable in the constructor.
tokenSymbol is only assigned to the symbol state variable in the constructor.
_from is the source address handled exclusively by _transfer.
_to is the destination address handled exclusively by _transfer.
_value is the moved amount handled exclusively by _transfer.
transfer forwards its _to argument directly to _transfer.
transfer forwards its _value argument directly to _transfer.
transferFrom forwards its _from argument to the allowance check and _transfer.
transferFrom forwards its _to argument to _transfer.
transferFrom uses _value for the allowance check and the transfer.
_spender is stored as the allowance key by approve.
_value is stored as the approved allowance by approve.
_spender is cast to tokenRecipient inside approveAndCall.
_value is passed into the external receiveApproval callback.
_extraData is forwarded to the external receiveApproval callback.
_value is the amount burned by burn.
